_comment: Parsed from Lights Back On Development Blueprint v1.0 (27 Oct 2026), section 4. title/role/hours/planned_weeks/depends_on/steps/acceptance are transcribed from the PDF. env/env_note/status/evidence_file were added when preparing the handoff (env is a judgement call). Hours are initial focused-effort estimates, not measured velocity.

status_values.IN_PROGRESS: work on a branch, not merged
status_values.CLOUD_VERIFIED: code and automated checks pass in a cloud/headless session; acceptance still needs the pending_local items
status_values.DONE: acceptance met AND docs/evidence/<ID>.md exists; only then
